newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PRIMEDIA IN TALKS, CAUTIONS UNITHOLDERS.
newsitem.headline: PRIMEDIA IN TALKS, CAUTIONS UNITHOLDERS.

text.p: Broadcasting and publishing company Primedia said on Tuesday it was talks which, if successfully concluded, could have an effect on the price of its combined units on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
Unitholders were advised to exercise caution when dealing in their combined units until a further announcement was made.
